## Design Settings » Homepage » Select Content to Display » Streaming Featured Blog Article Slider
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000099685

## Streaming Featured Blog Article Slider
This article goes over the available settings to edit the Streaming Featured Blog Article Slider section on the homepage of the website. This section is meant to be displayed on the homepage exclusively. This homepage widget will display the members selected to display as Featured Members of the website, to learn more about the process of setting up Featured Members, navigate to the following link: Featured Members on Homepage To edit these settings, navigate to:
In the Admin Sidebar Open Settings
Select Designs Settings
Open The Homepage Tab
Open The Module Select Content to Display
select The Streaming Featured Blog Article Slider Option

## Visual Guide of the Streaming Featured Blog Article Slider
This is a representation of the available settings for the Streaming Featured Blog Article Slider
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12143185722/original/zzAjWm1Q4sekDIaDl7M4uo7uVRXPwHSp7w.png?1715628271 | alt: ]

## 1. Featured Blog Article Slider
This setting controls which post type is linked to this section of the homepage.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12143185888/original/U_7ltx7qmElORnnpNmMNWg5VJFVQuUH28A.png?1715628488 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12143186331/original/hEkYNONLqomyb6BmT5ow0-o3wRsd17HYQA.png?1715628844 | alt: ]

## 2. Use Thumbnail on Mobile
This setting allows administrators to choose whether to display thumbnails on mobile devices. It is recommended to enable this option for better visual appeal on smaller screens.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12143186678/original/ILB50nNQBLljk2V_VkjPD2EMG-zdZq4Tng.png?1715629115 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144240933/original/cETSQcCNqcS6tiH4nOA7qFaxdkG9vwG7Wg.png?1717456852 | alt: ]

## 3. Background Color
The background color setting allows the customization of the slider's background color. Administrators can choose a color by inputting the desired color code or using the color picker tool provided.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144018754/original/piJ7lxV-t2qoROaTTYNQSPZbiacmtuqCEA.png?1717017086 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144018779/original/rQse4f1Tmqd0VyrXGwK5_GHGxzR2gH7_AQ.png?1717017141 | alt: ]

## 4. Font Color
This setting enables the customization of the font color for the slider. Administrators can choose a color by inputting the desired color code or using the color picker tool provided.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144018922/original/kAki-PppZynhpsWqJXfPffJC77ihe5TIlQ.png?1717017263 | alt: ]

## 5. Hover/Active Background Color
The hover/active background color setting allows the customization of the background color when an item in the slider is hovered over or active. Administrators can choose a color by inputting the desired color code or using the color picker tool provided.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144019050/original/Lxgmj9qF4nddtWzcuWy_woFlaQ-hRtTijg.png?1717017393 | alt: ]

## 6. Hover/Active Font Color
This setting enables the customization of the font color when an item in the slider is hovered over or active. Administrators can choose a color by inputting the desired color code or using the color picker tool provided.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144019152/original/kBu4rYcGhWBTz-j4eNO67WYIrJYH1TRtFg.png?1717017500 | alt: ]

## 7. Articles List Position
This setting controls the position of the articles list within the slider. Administrators can choose to display the list on the right or left side.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144019574/original/eznJO2Lj884NPeUw7H-Nxa5FgHDr3GayUg.png?1717017943 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144019563/original/93Vg7PDvEIl2v59HRUmarzZXZfmldANG7A.png?1717017928 | alt: ]

## 8. Hide On Mobile
This setting allows administrators to choose whether the blog article slider should be hidden on mobile devices. It can be enabled or disabled using the dropdown menu.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12144019513/original/WLiP84UR5-UIyrgPuijROo0YGV-heBxlqA.png?1717017831 | alt: ]
